rationale: The initial design is improved by increasing the number of sensors to five, arranged symmetrically across the front to better detect line position and curvature, which should improve line tracking and reduce line loss events. Sensor size is set to medium (0.012) to balance sensitivity and noise. The wheel track and wheel radius are set to moderate values (0.14 and 0.035) to provide stable turning without excessive wheel slip. The controller gains are adjusted to kp=0.9, ki=0.05, kd=0.15 to provide a responsive but stable PID control, reducing oscillations and improving error correction. Sensor weights are set to emphasize outer sensors negatively and center sensors less so, to better detect line deviation. The line loss behavior is set to 'search_left' to have a consistent recovery strategy. The observation request includes all key telemetry metrics to diagnose performance in the next iteration. This design aims to improve line following accuracy, reduce line loss events, and maintain stable control, expecting better progress and completion rates on the development tracks.
